review_notes: Segment 0: Repeated chanting lines 'नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः।' preserved as in source.

Please have a human reviewer check these segments against the lecture audio or authoritative Sanskrit sources before finalizing.
Segment 1: I preserved colloquial Hindi usages (e.g., 'वो', 'गीता जी') as spoken. Avoid changing these without speaker confirmation.

Segment 3: Possible ASR/word error: 'अद्रुव शब्द आ सकता है' — the term 'अद्रुव' is unclear in context and may be misrecognized (e.g., could be 'अद्रव्य' or another technical term). Please verify against audio or speaker notes.

Segment 3: Segment ends with a trailing idea in the next context ('हँस्यास' in following segment). The current segment ends mid-utterance; verify continuity in adjacent audio to confirm the intended word/form (e.g., 'हँस्यास्पद' or 'हँस्यास्पद').

Segment 4: Some Sanskrit/Sanskritized phrases (e.g., 'नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः', 'शीतोष्णादेः') were left largely as in the raw transcript; verify against the original text if precise diacritics/word-forms are required.
Segment 4: The correction 'असतः शीतोष्णादेः' was made with medium confidence—if a canonical rendering is needed, please cross-check with the source commentary.

Segment 5: Several short Sanskrit/Hindi fragments were left in their raw form where the meaning was uncertain (e.g., 'नास्ति भावः, न विद्यते का भी प्रायः नास्ति भावः, भवनम्, अस्तिता'). These phrases may merit human review for precise Sanskrit/Hindi normalization.
Segment 5: 'प्रमाणैर्हि निरूप्यमाणं वस्तु संभवति।' was retained as in transcript; the presence/absence of a negative (न) could alter meaning — please verify against the source text if available.
Segment 5: The compound 'सकारणम्' (as used in 'न शीतोष्णादि सकारणम्') was preserved from the raw transcript; grammatical form/case might require verification by a Sanskrit reader.
Segment 5: The passage ends mid-sentence ('घटादि जिस...') as in the raw segment; no reconstruction was attempted.
Segment 7: Kept 'घट' as spoken rather than changing to 'घड़ा' since the speaker consistently uses 'घट'; confirm if 'घट' is intended.
Segment 7: Terms/words left unchanged but possibly mis-transcribed or dialectal and may need human review: 'दुंदुकारी', 'नासुकरी'.
Segment 7: Sanskrit/technical phrase 'कारण व्यतिरेकेण तिष्ठन्ति ते' preserved as in raw text; verify exact classical form if authoritative citation is needed.
Segment 7: Phrase 'नारायण था नहीं' retained as spoken; context may require review to confirm intended meaning.

Segment 8: The colloquial phrase 'अरे रामा, महात्मा बड़े बिगड़ेल जात होती है ये' was preserved as spoken; verify if 'बिगड़ेल' should be 'बिगड़ैल' or another local colloquialism.

Segment 8: Sanskrit technical phrases (e.g., 'यस्माद् दृश्यं तस्माद् जडं, तस्मात् मिथ्या।' and 'मृदादि कारणस्य तत्त कारणस्य च तत् कारणव्यतिरेकेण अनुपलब्धेः असत्त्वम्।') were preserved with minimal edits; if an exact canonical wording is required, please have a subject-expert review them.
Segment 8: The segment ends mid-word ('...असद्बु' in the source). That truncation was preserved.

Segment 9: Left Sanskrit compounds and technical terms (e.g., 'सर्वत्र बुद्धिद्वयोपलब्धेः', 'सदसद् विभागे') as in the original; they appear correctly formed but may merit human review for canonical spacing/diacritics.

Please review and, if speaker intended a different word (e.g., 'काम' or 'कामा' or 'कुछ जोड़ दें'), update accordingly.
Segment 13: Word 'टोपे' in the phrase 'टोपे जैसे रहते हैं' may be an ASR error or colloquial; unclear. Please verify audio for intended wording.
Segment 13: The token 'बेविचार' ("बेविचार होगा कि नहीं होगा?") is uncertain in meaning/use here; confirm whether speaker said a different word (e.g., 'बेचैन', 'बेचेतन', or 'बेविचार').

Segment 13: Several Sanskritish passages (e.g., 'घटे विनष्टे घटबुद्धौ व्यभिचरन्त्यां सद्बुद्धिरपि व्यभिचरति इति चेत्।' and 'सद्बुद्धिवत् घटबुद्धिरपि घटान्तरे दृश्यते इति चेत्।') were left as in raw text where wording/spacing is uncertain; please verify against the recording if a canonical Sanskrit phrasing is required.
Segment 13: Segment ends mid-word ('कि घट तो नष्'); original audio should be checked for truncation or continuation in the next segment.
Segment 15: I replaced an unclear token 'निरास्पद' with a clarified phrasing; this edit is flagged for review in case the original intended Sanskrit/technical term was different.
Segment 15: Sanskrit-like phrases such as 'विशेषण विषया एव सा सद्बुद्धिः' and 'विशेष्य अभावात' were left as in the original; please verify if compound Sandhi forms or diacritics are desired.
Segment 16: A Sanskrit phrase ('प्रमाणैः हि निरूप्यमाणम् असत्') was split to improve readability; please verify against the original commentary if exact sandhi/wording is doctrinally significant.

Segment 16: Several other short Sanskrit technical terms (e.g., 'सद्बुद्धिः विशेषण विषयासति', 'विशेष अभावे विशेषण अनुपपत्तौ') were left as in the raw transcript because their precise canonical forms are uncertain; consider human review if exact wording is required.

changes.corrected: ये थोड़ा ग्राह्य शब्द है,

changes.corrected: नीलिमा

changes.corrected: शीतोष्ण लेते हैं।

changes.corrected: ये शीतोष्ण वास्तव में क्या हैं?
